title: Model onboarding: add metadata validator and automated release-notes hook
author: Maya Alvarez
description:
Motivation: onboarding models into the registry has grown ad-hoc metadata variations (missing quantization information, inconsistent perf profile formats) which blocks reliable automation (serving rollout, cost estimation, changelog generation). This PR introduces a small, extensible metadata validator (server-side and CLI) and a GitHub Action that synthesizes release notes for model profile changes so that model owners and release managers get an auditable changelog automatically.

What this PR does: 1) Adds a JSON Schema-based validator for model registry entries and exposes it as registry/validator.py and a CLI command rmdctl validate that runs local checks. 2) Adds a server-side validation hook used by the ingestion API to reject badly-formed metadata with clear error codes. 3) Introduces a GitHub Action (hooks/github/release-notes-action.yml) that computes a human-friendly release note when model metadata or performance profiles change (creates a CHANGES/MODELS.md entry). 4) Migration script for legacy entries that normalizes the perf_profile and quantization fields. 5) Tests and docs: unit + integration tests + onboarding docs update.

Checklist: - [x] validator implementation + CLI - [x] server-side hook integration - [x] release-notes GH Action and template - [x] migration for legacy entries - [x] unit/integration tests - [x] docs and example PR template

Backward compatibility and rollout: the API will enable validation by default for new model submissions. Existing models in the registry are migrated with a background job using migrations/2025-01-12-normalize-legacy-metadata.py; the migration is idempotent and logs changes to audit tables. The GH Action is opt-in via a repository-level config: .github/model-release-config.yml. We will enable the action for the main repo after this PR and monitor for two weeks before flipping the config to mandatory.

Usage examples: run `rmdctl validate path/to/model.json` locally to see a list of schema errors; a CI step is recommended for PRs that add or change models. The generated CHANGES/MODELS.md entries follow the template in docs/model-onboarding.md and include a short summary, performance delta table, and a link to perf artifacts in the benchmark-lab bucket.

Notes for reviewers: focus on the validator schema (registry/schema/model_v2.json) and the release-note diff algorithm (hooks/release_note_builder.py). The diff algorithm is intentionally conservative: it reports deltas only when a perf profile changes by >2% for top-level latency or throughput metrics to avoid noise in release notes.
commits: Add rmdctl validate command and unit tests (cli/rmdctl/validate.py, tests/test_validator.py)
Add GH Action for release notes and templating (hooks/github/release-notes-action.yml, hooks/release_note_builder.py)
Migration script for legacy metadata and audit logging (migrations/2025-01-12-normalize-legacy-metadata.py)
Fix lint issues and address review feedback
diff_snippets: hooks/github/release-notes-action.yml: on: [pull_request]; jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest; steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v3 - name: build release note - run: python hooks/release_note_builder.py --base ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} --head ${{ github.sha }} --out CHANGES/MODELS.md
cli/rmdctl/validate.py: def run(args): schema = load_schema('registry/schema/model_v2.json'); result = validate(json.load(args.input), schema); print(result.errors)
review_comments: Samir Patel: Can we make the perf profile validator accept multiple metric names (p50/p95/p99) but require at least one? Also request clearer error codes for CI to parse.
Maya Alvarez (author): Added required_metrics array and standardized error codes (REGVAL_001..). Updated tests to assert error code values.
Lena Cho: The GH Action should not write to CHANGES/MODELS.md directly on forked PRs. Can we make it post the candidate note as a comment instead?
Maya Alvarez: Adjusted action: on forked PRs we post a draft comment and attach artifacts; for trusted branches we write the file and open a PR. Added config flag allow_write_changelog.
Samir Patel: Integration test flaked once (timeout in test_release_notes). Please add a backoff/retry for S3 artifact fetch.
Maya Alvarez: Added exponential backoff and increased test timeout; CI green on rerun.
ci_checks: lint: initial run failed (flake8 E303) -> fixed
release_notes: Added model metadata validator and release-notes automation: - New CLI command `rmdctl validate` for pre-PR checks - Server-side validation rejects malformed model metadata with structured error codes - GitHub Action that synthesizes CHANGES/MODELS.md entries for model/profile changes (opt-in via .github/model-release-config.yml) - Background migration to normalize legacy metadata - Docs: expanded model onboarding guide and PR template
notes_for_ops: When enabling the action repo-wide, set allow_write_changelog to false initially and monitor the CHANGES/MODELS.md PRs. The migration is idempotent but should be run with read-only dry-run first (migrations/2025-01-12-normalize-legacy-metadata.py --dry-run). Audit logs are written to registry.audit_model_changes.
rollback_plan: If the validator blocks critical submissions, flip ingestion.validate=false in the registry config to disable server-side enforcement, then run a targeted migration to normalize problematic models. GH Action can be disabled by removing .github/model-release-config.yml.
post_merge_actions: Enable GH Action in staging after deploying the validator to ingestion-api; run migration in background and monitor audit table; schedule a 2-week review to decide on mandatory enforcement.
notes: This change is intentionally conservative: the release-note generator thresholds are tunable via .github/model-release-config.yml to avoid noisy changelogs. The validator schema is extensible for future perf metrics (memory, fp16 stability flags).
footprint_estimate: Adds ~800 LOC across validator, CLI, action and tests; negligible runtime cost for ingestion API (schema check only).
